answer.summary: Spring ApplicationContext fails to start in the api-tests shard, so every test that loads the app context errors out. The cause is a circular bean dependency (workflowService -> workflowEndService -> notificationEventService -> scenarioNotificationEventHandler -> exerciseService -> workflowService), which is deterministic and will repeat on rerun. The PR only touches a test file, so the log does not show that this change introduced the cycle, and the failure has also appeared in an earlier run.

evidence.quote: Relying upon circular references is discouraged and they are prohibited by default. Update your application to remove the dependency cycle between beans.

Caused by: org.springframework.beans.factory.BeanCurrentlyInCreationException: Error creating bean with name 'workflowService': Requested bean is currently in creation: Is there an unresolvable circular reference or an asynchronous initialization dependency?
